component.name: gameboy
component.summary: Game Boy (DMG) emulator with an SDL2 frontend

description.p: A Game Boy (DMG) emulator in C++20 with an SDL2 window, audio and keyboard controls, validated against blargg's test ROMs and dmg-acid2. Open a .gb file with it, or run it with a ROM: flatpak run com.dhivalabs.gameboy game.gb
